# Vendored pack libraries

`bothy_packs.py` and `bothy_pack_files.py` are copied unchanged from the Bothy repo
(`services/knowledge-packs/`), so these checks read packs exactly the way a deck does.

Copied from Bothy 0.1.2 (Knowledge entries: kinds, quick facts, key facts, tables, callouts, see also; packs
that use them name "minBothy": "0.1.2"). When the pack format changes in Bothy, copy both files again and
note the new commit here.
